questions.question: What animal says MOO?
questions.hint: It lives on a farm and gives us milk

questions.question: What animal has a long neck and eats leaves from tall trees?
questions.hint: It is the tallest animal in the world

questions.question: What animal can change its color to hide from predators?
questions.hint: It is a type of lizard

questions.question: What do you call a baby dog?
questions.hint: It is small and very playful

questions.question: Which animal sleeps all winter long?
questions.hint: This is called hibernation

questions.question: What animal has stripes and lives in Africa?
questions.hint: It looks like a horse with black and white stripes

questions.question: What is the biggest animal in the ocean?
questions.hint: It is also the biggest animal on Earth

questions.question: What animal builds dams out of sticks?
questions.hint: It has big front teeth and a flat tail

questions.question: What color do you get when you mix red and blue?
questions.hint: Think of grapes or lavender flowers

questions.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
questions.hint: Count them: one, two, three

questions.question: What shape is a pizza?
questions.hint: It is perfectly round with no corners

questions.question: What color is the sky on a sunny day?
questions.hint: It is also the color of the ocean

questions.question: What shape has 8 sides?
questions.hint: You see this shape on stop signs

questions.question: What colors are in a rainbow?
questions.answer: RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, INDIGO, VIOLET! 🌈
questions.hint: Think ROY G BIV

questions.question: What color do you get when you mix yellow and blue?
questions.hint: It is the color of grass and leaves

questions.question: How many corners does a square have?
questions.hint: All four sides are the same length

questions.question: What is 2 + 2?
questions.hint: Count on your fingers: 1, 2 plus 1, 2 more

questions.question: How many fingers do you have on both hands?
questions.hint: Count all your fingers together

questions.question: What is 5 + 3?
questions.hint: Start at 5 and count up 3 more

questions.question: If you have 10 apples and eat 3, how many are left?
questions.hint: Start at 10 and count back 3

questions.question: What number comes after 19?
questions.hint: Count to 19 and say the next number

questions.question: How many days are in a week?
questions.hint: Monday through Sunday

questions.question: What is half of 10?
questions.hint: Split 10 into two equal groups

questions.question: How many months are in a year?
questions.hint: January through December

questions.question: What letter does the word APPLE start with?
questions.hint: It is the first letter of the alphabet

questions.question: How many letters are in the alphabet?
questions.hint: Start singing the ABC song

questions.question: What is the opposite of the word HOT?
questions.hint: Think about ice cream or snow

questions.question: What do we call words that describe a noun like big, small, or happy?
questions.hint: They are describing words

questions.question: What letter comes right before Z in the alphabet?
questions.hint: Think of the very end of the ABC song

questions.question: What letter does BALL start with?
questions.hint: It makes a buh sound

questions.question: Which of these words rhymes with CAT?
questions.hint: Listen for the same ending sound: -AT

questions.question: What are the 5 vowels in the alphabet?
questions.hint: They are special letters that every word needs

questions.question: What do clouds produce when they are very full?
questions.hint: You need an umbrella when this happens

questions.question: What is the closest star to Earth?
questions.hint: It rises every morning and sets every evening

questions.question: What season comes after summer?
questions.hint: Leaves change colors and fall off trees

questions.question: What do we call a very big storm with lots of spinning wind?
questions.hint: It looks like a funnel coming from the sky

questions.question: What is the process called when water evaporates and comes back as rain?
questions.hint: It goes evaporate, condense, precipitate

questions.question: What do plants need to grow?
questions.hint: Think about what you give a houseplant

questions.question: What is frozen rain called?
questions.hint: Children love to play in it and build snowmen

questions.question: What is the name of our planet?
questions.hint: We all live here — it is the third planet from the sun

questions.question: What fruit is red, round, and grows on trees?
questions.hint: A doctor a day keeps the doctor away

questions.question: What food group gives us energy like bread, pasta, and rice?
questions.hint: They are often made from wheat or other grains

questions.question: What do we call the most important meal of the day?
questions.hint: You eat it in the morning to start your day

questions.question: What vitamin do we get mostly from the sun and milk?
questions.hint: It helps make your bones strong

questions.question: How many servings of fruits and vegetables should you eat each day?
questions.hint: Eat a rainbow of colors every day

questions.question: What is the yellow fruit monkeys love to eat?
questions.hint: It is long, curved, and yellow

questions.question: What drink helps make your bones and teeth strong?
questions.hint: It comes from cows and has lots of calcium

questions.question: What vegetable is orange, crunchy, and rabbits love?
questions.hint: It grows underground

questions.question: What body part do you use to smell flowers?
questions.hint: It is in the middle of your face

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.hint: You have more as a baby — they fuse together as you grow

questions.question: What organ pumps blood through your body?
questions.hint: You can feel it beating in your chest

questions.question: What do we call the protective layer that covers our bodies?
questions.hint: It comes in many different beautiful colors

questions.question: What organ controls everything your body does?
questions.hint: It lives inside your skull and never stops working

questions.question: What do you use to see the world around you?
questions.hint: You blink them to keep them moist

questions.question: What body part do you use to taste your food?
questions.hint: It is inside your mouth and helps you talk too

questions.question: What do your lungs help you do?
questions.hint: You do it about 20,000 times every day

questions.question: What do you feel when something makes you very happy?
questions.hint: Your face smiles really big

questions.question: What is it called when you feel worried about something?
questions.hint: Your tummy might feel fluttery or upset

questions.question: What do you do to show someone you care about them?
questions.answer: GIVE A HUG, SAY KIND WORDS, or HELP THEM! 🤗
questions.hint: Think about what makes you feel loved

questions.question: What should you do when someone is sad?
questions.hint: You can listen, give a hug, or just be there for them

questions.question: What is the word for understanding how other people feel?
questions.hint: It means putting yourself in someone else's shoes

questions.question: What do you say when someone gives you something?
questions.hint: It is a very important word to know

questions.question: What feeling do you get when someone takes your toy without asking?
questions.hint: It is okay to feel this — talk about it!

questions.question: What is a good way to solve a problem with a friend?
questions.hint: Use your words and listen to each other
